idealistShard.name: Idealist Shard
idealistShard.description:
Lower self Physical and Magic Damage (-{{penalty}}%) ({{duration}} turns). 
Raise all group members Speed (+{{speed}}%) ({{duration}} turns).

monarchShard.name: Monarch Shard
monarchShard.description: Increase all party members stats by {{bonus}}% for {{duration}} turns.

survivalInstinct.name: Survival Instinct
survivalInstinct.description: Increase Physical Damage ({{attack}}%), Critical Chance ({{critChance}}%), Critical Damage ({{critDamage}}%) and Speed ({{speed}}%) while HP is lower than 25%.

theDullBlade.name: The Dull Blade
theDullBlade.description: Lower self Physical and Magic Defence (-{{defence}}%). Raise Physical Attack (+{{attack}}%), Critical Chance (+{{critChance}}%), Critical Damage (+{{critDamage}}%), and Speed (+{{speed}}%) ({{duration}} turns).

vulnerableShard.name: Vulnerable Shard
vulnerableShard.description: Lower self Physical and Magic Defence (-{{defence}}%) and raise Speed (+{{speed}}%) ({{duration}} turns).

waterDominion.name: Water Dominion
waterDominion.description: Grant self the ability to exploit cold weakness with any attack (based on Physical Damage). Raise Cold Damage (+{{coldDmg}}%), Heat Resistance (+{{heatResistance}}%), and Physical Damage (+{{speedBonus}}% per 100 Speed points) ({{duration}} turns).

burn.name: Burn
burn.description: Deals Heat damage each turn. Stacks increase damage by 10% per 5 burn stacks.

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.description: Reduces target speed by 5% (max 30%). Increases damage by 5% per 5 frostbite stacks.

paralysis.name: Paralysis
paralysis.description: Chance to make target unable to act.

poison.name: Poison
poison.description: Deals Toxin damage each turn. Stacks increase damage by 10% per 5 poison stacks.
